dialogue.text: Two weeks ago, under flickering neon in a downtown bar
dialogue.zh: 兩週前，在市中心酒吧閃爍的霓虹燈下
dialogue.ja: 二週間前、ダウンタウンのバーでちらつくネオンの下で
dialogue.local: Two weeks ago, under flickering neon in a downtown bar
dialogue.en: Two weeks ago, under flickering neon in a downtown bar

dialogue.text: You sit into the sea like you've been waiting for my scar
dialogue.zh: 你坐在海邊，彷彿一直在等待我的傷痕
dialogue.ja: まるで私の傷跡を待っていたかのように、君は海に座っている
dialogue.local: You sit into the sea like you've been waiting for my scar
dialogue.en: You sit into the sea like you've been waiting for my scar

dialogue.text: You're locked up through the smoke shop during my last hand
dialogue.zh: 你被困在煙草店裡，正值我最後一手牌時
dialogue.ja: 私の最後の手の間、君は煙草屋に閉じ込められていた
dialogue.local: You're locked up through the smoke shop during my last hand
dialogue.en: You're locked up through the smoke shop during my last hand

dialogue.text: I told myself just coffee but the rain had other plans
dialogue.zh: 我告訴自己只是喝咖啡，但雨卻另有安排
dialogue.ja: 自分にコーヒーだけだと言い聞かせたけど、雨は別の計画を持っていた
dialogue.local: I told myself just coffee but the rain had other plans
dialogue.en: I told myself just coffee but the rain had other plans

dialogue.text: You walk the same quiet sidewalks where I used to chase my ghost
dialogue.zh: 你走在我曾經追逐幽靈的同一條寧靜人行道上
dialogue.ja: 君は私がかつて幽霊を追いかけた同じ静かな歩道を歩いている
dialogue.local: You walk the same quiet sidewalks where I used to chase my ghost
dialogue.en: You walk the same quiet sidewalks where I used to chase my ghost

dialogue.text: You courted my holy ricks like a memorized the most
dialogue.zh: 你追求我的神聖領地，彷彿記住了最多的細節
dialogue.ja: 君は私の聖なる領域を求め、まるで最も覚えているかのように
dialogue.local: You courted my holy ricks like a memorized the most
dialogue.en: You courted my holy ricks like a memorized the most

dialogue.text: By day three we would train secrets in the passing just see
dialogue.zh: 到了第三天，我們會在擦肩而過中訓練秘密，只是看看
dialogue.ja: 三日目には、すれ違いの中で秘密を訓練していた、ただ見ているだけ
dialogue.local: By day three we would train secrets in the passing just see
dialogue.en: By day three we would train secrets in the passing just see

dialogue.text: Your hand on my knee saying things my husband couldn't repeat
dialogue.zh: 你的手放在我的膝蓋上，說著我丈夫無法重複的話
dialogue.ja: 君の手が私の膝の上にあり、夫が言えなかったことを語っていた
dialogue.local: Your hand on my knee saying things my husband couldn't repeat
dialogue.en: Your hand on my knee saying things my husband couldn't repeat

dialogue.text: I counted every sign on us like it might be the last
dialogue.zh: 我數著我們身上的每個跡象，彷彿這可能是最後一次
dialogue.ja: これが最後かもしれないと思い、私たちのすべての兆候を数えた
dialogue.local: I counted every sign on us like it might be the last
dialogue.en: I counted every sign on us like it might be the last

dialogue.text: For it's me in place through when everything must fall alive
dialogue.zh: 因為當一切必須活著崩塌時，是我在這裡
dialogue.ja: すべてが生きて崩れなければならない時、そこにいるのは私だ
dialogue.local: For it's me in place through when everything must fall alive
dialogue.en: For it's me in place through when everything must fall alive

dialogue.text: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor
dialogue.zh: 那是一個激烈爭鬥的夜晚，寶貝，比海底還深
dialogue.ja: それは深く戦った夜だった、ベイビー、海底よりも深く
dialogue.local: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor
dialogue.en: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor

dialogue.text: Two weeks old, almost full, ever knocking at my door
dialogue.zh: 兩週大，幾乎滿月，總是在敲我的門
dialogue.ja: 二週間経ち、ほぼ満月、いつも私のドアをノックしている
dialogue.local: Two weeks old, almost full, ever knocking at my door
dialogue.en: Two weeks old, almost full, ever knocking at my door

dialogue.text: You called your name and see the parts of me I locked away
dialogue.zh: 你叫著你的名字，看見我封鎖起來的部分自己
dialogue.ja: 君は自分の名前を呼び、私が閉ざした部分を見た
dialogue.local: You called your name and see the parts of me I locked away
dialogue.en: You called your name and see the parts of me I locked away

dialogue.text: Now I'm drowned in the silence of the life I have to save
dialogue.zh: 現在我淹沒在必須拯救的生命的沉默中
dialogue.ja: 今、私は救わなければならない人生の沈黙に溺れている
dialogue.local: Now I'm drowned in the silence of the life I have to save
dialogue.en: Now I'm drowned in the silence of the life I have to save

dialogue.text: For it's me in place through when everything must fall alive
dialogue.zh: 因為當一切必須活著崩塌時，是我在這裡
dialogue.ja: すべてが生きて崩れなければならない時、そこにいるのは私だ
dialogue.local: For it's me in place through when everything must fall alive
dialogue.en: For it's me in place through when everything must fall alive

dialogue.text: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor
dialogue.zh: 那是一個激烈爭鬥的夜晚，寶貝，比海底還深
dialogue.ja: それは深く戦った夜だった、ベイビー、海底よりも深く
dialogue.local: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor
dialogue.en: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor

dialogue.text: I still take the whiskey on your lips when I close my eyes
dialogue.zh: 當我閉上眼睛時，我仍感受到你嘴唇上的威士忌味
dialogue.ja: 目を閉じると、君の唇のウイスキーの味がまだする
dialogue.local: I still take the whiskey on your lips when I close my eyes
dialogue.en: I still take the whiskey on your lips when I close my eyes

dialogue.text: Think for the night I'm never gonna be the same
dialogue.zh: 想著這一夜，我將永遠不會一樣
dialogue.ja: その夜のことを考えると、私はもう同じではいられない
dialogue.local: Think for the night I'm never gonna be the same
dialogue.en: Think for the night I'm never gonna be the same

dialogue.text: They fired me down too late, the weather will always touch the sky
dialogue.zh: 他們太晚解雇了我，天氣總會觸及天空
dialogue.ja: 彼らは私を遅すぎて解雇した、天気はいつも空に触れるだろう
dialogue.local: They fired me down too late, the weather will always touch the sky
dialogue.en: They fired me down too late, the weather will always touch the sky

dialogue.text: They played my favorite song on guitar while the fireflies went by
dialogue.zh: 當螢火蟲飛過時，他們用吉他彈奏我最喜歡的歌
dialogue.ja: 蛍が飛び交う中、彼らは私の好きな曲をギターで演奏した
dialogue.local: They played my favorite song on guitar while the fireflies went by
dialogue.en: They played my favorite song on guitar while the fireflies went by

dialogue.text: Told me how my voice saved you and the world went dark and cold
dialogue.zh: 告訴我我的聲音如何拯救了你，而世界變得黑暗寒冷
dialogue.ja: 私の声が君を救ったと教えてくれた、そして世界は暗く冷たくなった
dialogue.local: Told me how my voice saved you and the world went dark and cold
dialogue.en: Told me how my voice saved you and the world went dark and cold

dialogue.text: I laughed until I cried
dialogue.zh: 我笑到流淚
dialogue.ja: 私は泣くまで笑った
dialogue.local: I laughed until I cried
dialogue.en: I laughed until I cried

dialogue.text: Cause no one's ever called me home
dialogue.zh: 因為從沒有人叫我回家
dialogue.ja: 誰も私を家に呼んだことがなかったから
dialogue.local: Cause no one's ever called me home
dialogue.en: Cause no one's ever called me home

dialogue.text: By day nine we would change with open coke, sell sheets and true love
dialogue.zh: 到了第九天，我們會用開放的可樂改變，販賣床單和真愛
dialogue.ja: 九日目には、開けたコーラで変わり、シーツと真実の愛を売った
dialogue.local: By day nine we would change with open coke, sell sheets and true love
dialogue.en: By day nine we would change with open coke, sell sheets and true love

dialogue.text: Your fingers chasing me, boys, on my skin beneath my youth
dialogue.zh: 你的手指在我青春的肌膚上追逐我，男孩們
dialogue.ja: 君の指が私の若さの下の肌を追いかけていた、少年たちよ
dialogue.local: Your fingers chasing me, boys, on my skin beneath my youth
dialogue.en: Your fingers chasing me, boys, on my skin beneath my youth

dialogue.text: You said I'd burn a hole on the features of said word
dialogue.zh: 你說我會在那句話的特徵上燒出一個洞
dialogue.ja: 君は私がその言葉の特徴に穴を焼くと言った
dialogue.local: You said I'd burn a hole on the features of said word
dialogue.en: You said I'd burn a hole on the features of said word

dialogue.text: I whispered, don't you dare, but my heart already hurt
dialogue.zh: 我低聲說，別敢這樣，但我的心已經受傷了
dialogue.ja: 私はささやいた、そんなことしないでと、でも心はもう痛んでいた
dialogue.local: I whispered, don't you dare, but my heart already hurt
dialogue.en: I whispered, don't you dare, but my heart already hurt

dialogue.text: I come in every heartbeat like a tambourine bomb
dialogue.zh: 我像鈴鼓炸彈一樣在每個心跳中出現
dialogue.ja: 私はタンバリンの爆弾のように一つ一つの鼓動でやってくる
dialogue.local: I come in every heartbeat like a tambourine bomb
dialogue.en: I come in every heartbeat like a tambourine bomb

dialogue.text: Fourteen days until the light, our build would all be gone
dialogue.zh: 還有十四天直到光明，我們的建構都將消失
dialogue.ja: 光が差すまで十四日、私たちの築いたものはすべて消えるだろう
dialogue.local: Fourteen days until the light, our build would all be gone
dialogue.en: Fourteen days until the light, our build would all be gone

dialogue.text: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor
dialogue.zh: 那是一個激烈爭鬥的夜晚，寶貝，比海底還深
dialogue.ja: それは深く戦った夜だった、ベイビー、海底よりも深く
dialogue.local: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor
dialogue.en: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor

dialogue.text: I said I'd burn a hole on the features of said word
dialogue.zh: 我說我會在那句話的特徵上燒出一個洞
dialogue.ja: 私はその言葉の特徴に穴を焼くと言った
dialogue.local: I said I'd burn a hole on the features of said word
dialogue.en: I said I'd burn a hole on the features of said word

dialogue.text: You said I'd burn a hole on the features of said word
dialogue.zh: 你說我會在那句話的特徵上燒出一個洞
dialogue.ja: 君は私がその言葉の特徴に穴を焼くと言った
dialogue.local: You said I'd burn a hole on the features of said word
dialogue.en: You said I'd burn a hole on the features of said word

dialogue.text: Now I'm drowning in silence for the love I have to steal
dialogue.zh: 現在我淹沒在沉默中，為了我必須偷走的愛
dialogue.ja: 今、私は盗まなければならない愛のために沈黙に溺れている
dialogue.local: Now I'm drowning in silence for the love I have to steal
dialogue.en: Now I'm drowning in silence for the love I have to steal

dialogue.text: Deep-fought night, yeah, fell a kiss
dialogue.zh: 激烈爭鬥的夜晚，是的，落下了一個吻
dialogue.ja: 激しく戦った夜、そう、キスが落ちた
dialogue.local: Deep-fought night, yeah, fell a kiss
dialogue.en: Deep-fought night, yeah, fell a kiss

dialogue.text: And fourteen nights of interest like a fresh air
dialogue.zh: 還有十四個夜晚的興趣，如同新鮮空氣
dialogue.ja: そして新鮮な空気のような十四夜の興味
dialogue.local: And fourteen nights of interest like a fresh air
dialogue.en: And fourteen nights of interest like a fresh air

dialogue.text: They touch a good guy in the skies
dialogue.zh: 他們觸碰天空中的好人
dialogue.ja: 彼らは空の中の良い人に触れる
dialogue.local: They touch a good guy in the skies
dialogue.en: They touch a good guy in the skies

dialogue.text: I stayed, said the whiskey on your lips when I close my eyes
dialogue.zh: 我留下來了，說當我閉上眼睛時感受到你嘴唇上的威士忌
dialogue.ja: 私は残った、目を閉じると君の唇のウイスキーを感じると言った
dialogue.local: I stayed, said the whiskey on your lips when I close my eyes
dialogue.en: I stayed, said the whiskey on your lips when I close my eyes

dialogue.text: Deep-fought night, oh, I had no need to sound me
dialogue.zh: 激烈爭鬥的夜晚，哦，我不需要表現自己
dialogue.ja: 激しく戦った夜、ああ、私は自分を表現する必要はなかった
dialogue.local: Deep-fought night, oh, I had no need to sound me
dialogue.en: Deep-fought night, oh, I had no need to sound me

dialogue.text: Day twelve you looked at me like I was already done
dialogue.zh: 第十二天你看著我，彷彿我已經結束了
dialogue.ja: 十二日目、君は私をまるで終わったかのように見た
dialogue.local: Day twelve you looked at me like I was already done
dialogue.en: Day twelve you looked at me like I was already done

dialogue.text: Said I know I'm going back to tell me I was wrong
dialogue.zh: 說我知道我要回去告訴自己我錯了
dialogue.ja: 私は間違っていたと自分に言いに戻ると君は言った
dialogue.local: Said I know I'm going back to tell me I was wrong
dialogue.en: Said I know I'm going back to tell me I was wrong

dialogue.text: I packed my suitcase, slowly folding all the things I never say
dialogue.zh: 我收拾行李，慢慢折疊所有我從未說過的話
dialogue.ja: 私はスーツケースを詰め、言わなかったすべてのことをゆっくりと折りたたんだ
dialogue.local: I packed my suitcase, slowly folding all the things I never say
dialogue.en: I packed my suitcase, slowly folding all the things I never say

dialogue.text: You kissed the tears, laid off my cheeks and let me walk away
dialogue.zh: 你吻去淚水，輕撫我的臉頰，讓我離開
dialogue.ja: 君は涙にキスをし、私の頬を撫でて私を歩かせた
dialogue.local: You kissed the tears, laid off my cheeks and let me walk away
dialogue.en: You kissed the tears, laid off my cheeks and let me walk away

dialogue.text: It was a deep-fought night, yeah, fell a kiss
dialogue.zh: 那是一個激烈爭鬥的夜晚，是的，落下了一個吻
dialogue.ja: それは深く戦った夜だった、そう、キスが落ちた
dialogue.local: It was a deep-fought night, yeah, fell a kiss
dialogue.en: It was a deep-fought night, yeah, fell a kiss

dialogue.text: And fourteen nights until the light, our build would all be gone
dialogue.zh: 還有十四個夜晚直到光明，我們的建構都將消失
dialogue.ja: 光が差すまで十四夜、私たちの築いたものはすべて消えるだろう
dialogue.local: And fourteen nights until the light, our build would all be gone
dialogue.en: And fourteen nights until the light, our build would all be gone

dialogue.text: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor
dialogue.zh: 那是一個激烈爭鬥的夜晚，寶貝，比海底還深
dialogue.ja: それは深く戦った夜だった、ベイビー、海底よりも深く
dialogue.local: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor
dialogue.en: It was a deep-fought night, baby, deeper than the ocean floor

dialogue.text: Three nights of almost seven days, don't ever let go
dialogue.zh: 三個夜晚，幾乎七天，永遠不要放手
dialogue.ja: ほぼ七日間の三夜、決して手を離さないで
dialogue.local: Three nights of almost seven days, don't ever let go
dialogue.en: Three nights of almost seven days, don't ever let go

dialogue.text: He left a record in the quiet alarm that he'd been
dialogue.zh: 他在寂靜的警報中留下了他的紀錄
dialogue.ja: 彼は静かな警報に自分がいた記録を残した
dialogue.local: He left a record in the quiet alarm that he'd been
dialogue.en: He left a record in the quiet alarm that he'd been

dialogue.text: Now every song I'd write is tamed with words I never said
dialogue.zh: 現在我寫的每首歌都被我未曾說出的話馴服
dialogue.ja: 今、私が書くすべての歌は言わなかった言葉で抑えられている
dialogue.local: Now every song I'd write is tamed with words I never said
dialogue.en: Now every song I'd write is tamed with words I never said

dialogue.text: Deep-fought ten, fourteen nights that felt like twenty years
dialogue.zh: 激烈爭鬥的十天，十四個夜晚感覺像二十年
dialogue.ja: 激しく戦った十日間、二十年のように感じた十四夜
dialogue.local: Deep-fought ten, fourteen nights that felt like twenty years
dialogue.en: Deep-fought ten, fourteen nights that felt like twenty years

dialogue.text: I'll tell you by the way you said my name between the tears
dialogue.zh: 我會告訴你，從你在淚水中叫我的名字的方式
dialogue.ja: 涙の間に君が私の名前を呼んだその方法で伝えるよ
dialogue.local: I'll tell you by the way you said my name between the tears
dialogue.en: I'll tell you by the way you said my name between the tears

dialogue.text: And for the days of Susan and ours was a hurricane
dialogue.zh: 而蘇珊的日子和我們的日子是一場颶風
dialogue.ja: スーザンの日々と私たちの日々はハリケーンだった
dialogue.local: And for the days of Susan and ours was a hurricane
dialogue.en: And for the days of Susan and ours was a hurricane

dialogue.text: Deep-fought night, I'm carrying mine
dialogue.zh: 激烈爭鬥的夜晚，我背負著我的
dialogue.ja: 激しく戦った夜、私は自分のものを背負っている
dialogue.local: Deep-fought night, I'm carrying mine
dialogue.en: Deep-fought night, I'm carrying mine

dialogue.text: Two weeks ago I met you, three weeks ago I lost you
dialogue.zh: 兩週前我遇見你，三週前我失去你
dialogue.ja: 二週間前に君に出会い、三週間前に君を失った
dialogue.local: Two weeks ago I met you, three weeks ago I lost you
dialogue.en: Two weeks ago I met you, three weeks ago I lost you

dialogue.text: Deep-fought night, I'm still counting the days
dialogue.zh: 激烈爭鬥的夜晚，我仍在數著日子
dialogue.ja: 激しく戦った夜、私はまだ日々を数えている
dialogue.local: Deep-fought night, I'm still counting the days
dialogue.en: Deep-fought night, I'm still counting the days
